## About
Kings Automotive & Transmission is a family-owned and operated repair shop in Keller, TX. We work on a wide range of vehicles, and our specialty is transmission and engine repair.
Daniel and Stephanie run things the way they'd want their own car handled: honest answers, updates along the way, and no repairs you don't need. We serve Keller and the surrounding areas, and we treat every customer with respect.

## Services
- Transmission rebuild: When a transmission goes out, we can rebuild it and get you back on the road.
- Transmission service: Routine service on your transmission fluid to keep things running smoothly.
- Engine repair: Engine work is one of our specialties, along with transmissions.
- Check engine light diagnostics: If that light comes on, bring it in and we'll find out why.
- Rack and pinion: We've repaired the rack and pinion for customers' vehicles.
- Transfer case: We diagnose transfer case leaks and get the transfer case replaced when it's needed.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Send us a text, give us a call, or leave a work request through the contact form and we'll get back to you.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: A wide range of vehicles, including diesel engines and motorcycles.
